Title: Implement SSE streaming for long tool responses (review_code, agent_task)
Description: review_code architecture focus currently takes 12+ seconds and returns in one block. Streaming tokens as they arrive would dramatically improve perceived responsiveness. The OllamaClient already returns IAsyncEnumerable<string>; the MCP layer needs to forward that stream. Requires Streamable HTTP transport (already configured) and MCP server SDK streaming support. Most impactful for review_code and agent_task long outputs.
